fields.System.Title: OUT-605 — Notify the ERP of dispatch
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a finance team member, I want the ERP told as soon as goods ship, so that invoices
are raised promptly and accurately.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given dispatch confirmation, then outbound.order_shipped is written to the outbox in
  • the same transaction.
  • - Given the ERP is unavailable, then the event is retried and warehouse work is
  • unaffected.
  • - Given the event, then it carries order reference, shipped quantities per line,
  • carrier, and tracking reference.
  • - Given delivery fails repeatedly, then the event moves to the dead-letter store and an
  • alert is raised.
  • - Given the event is delivered twice, then the ERP is documented as required to
  • deduplicate on event_id.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, platform |
| Tables | outbox |
| Risks | Notification lost, so no invoice raised ([doc 09 §2.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); duplicate invoicing ([doc 09 §3.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration · event assertion |
